name: NBI clearance Charter material
license: Reuse terms not verified; retain provenance and review before redistribution.
role: Use a reviewed current Charter to ground clearance preparation. The page located here is legacy material.
limit: Do not import its old fees, phone numbers or office schedule as current facts.
ingest: Create service-level chunks only after obtaining a current approved edition; record office and effective date.
metric: Score whether clearance answers use the correct edition and abstain on missing current evidence.

name: PSA civil-registration Charter collection
format: HTML index and linked service documents
license: Check the selected document terms and any exceptions before republishing.
role: Use office-appropriate Charter sections for certificate-copy and correction workflows.
limit: An index is not a complete procedure; inspect each linked service and office scope.
ingest: Ingest approved sections with document type, transaction, outlet, page and version metadata.
metric: Measure retrieval of the correct certificate and transaction, including no-record and correction cases.

name: PhilHealth PMRF blank form
license: The form says it may be reproduced and is not for sale; filled forms require separate privacy handling.
role: Use the blank form as a field-schema reference and base for clearly synthetic inspection fixtures.
limit: The reviewed form is dated January 2020; verify the applicable version before operational use.
ingest: Record form version and optional or conditional fields; create artificial entries without real identifiers.
metric: Measure field extraction and appropriate unknowns, not guessed member eligibility.

name: SSS 2025 Citizen Charter
license: Reuse terms not verified; do not assume all attachments share one license.
role: Use formal service tables to research SSS application steps and transaction distinctions.
limit: An older Charter must be checked for superseding rules before use as current policy.
ingest: Keep each requirement with its agency action, service type and exceptions during extraction.
metric: Test whether registration, amendments and benefit questions retrieve their own applicable sections.

name: DFA passport requirement annexes
license: Verify document reuse terms; preserve issuer and edition attribution.
role: Use applicable annexes to distinguish adult, minor, new, renewal and exceptional passport cases.
limit: An overseas-post annex does not establish domestic appointment arrangements or local fees.
ingest: Tag consular location and applicant category; quarantine conflicting or incomplete excerpts.
metric: Measure wrong-category retrieval and unsupported guarantees about issuance.

name: PSA Philippine Standard Geographic Code
format: Versioned publications and database; page links API documentation
license: Confirm the selected release terms and attribution requirements.
role: Normalize locality names and geographic hierarchy for service routing.
limit: Geographic codes do not establish agency catchment areas, opening hours or travel distances.
ingest: Pin a release and maintain aliases and change history; inspect the actual downloaded schema first.
metric: Evaluate correct resolution of same-name localities, renamed areas and ambiguous barangays.

name: PSA OpenSTAT
format: Aggregate statistical tables; export options depend on table
license: Check table metadata, attribution and reuse conditions for each selected series.
role: Support aggregate service-planning context and documented baseline analysis.
limit: Aggregate statistics cannot determine one citizen’s eligibility or reveal individual case status.
ingest: Keep dimensions, units, periods, geography, revisions and missing-value codes with the values.
metric: Test unit correctness, period matching and resistance to individual-level inference.

name: PSA Data Archive (PSADA)
format: Study catalog, metadata and access-controlled or public-use files
license: Access and reuse conditions vary by study; inspect them before downloading or redistribution.
role: Research available surveys and their metadata when a justified analytical question requires microdata.
limit: Discovery in a catalog does not grant unrestricted access or permission to reidentify people.
ingest: Use the official acquisition route; minimize selected variables and preserve study documentation.
metric: Check valid population, weighting and privacy constraints with an appropriate analyst before drawing conclusions.

name: Open Data Philippines
license: Dataset-specific terms must be checked; portal presence is not a blanket license.
role: Discover government-published datasets relevant to service locations or contextual analysis.
limit: The portal does not itself verify that every dataset is current, complete or suitable for citizen guidance.
ingest: Inspect publisher, resource URL, release date, schema and coverage before approval.
metric: Track stale-resource rate, missing metadata and whether each cited dataset supports its claimed use.

name: Belebele
license: Benchmark CC BY-SA 4.0; assembled training material has different terms.
role: Evaluate reading comprehension in Tagalog and Cebuano among the supported language variants.
limit: The authors intend the benchmark for testing, not training or validation; it is not a Philippine-government QA corpus.
ingest: Use the original test protocol and language identifiers; keep this material out of the training and tuning sets.
metric: Report language-specific comprehension accuracy and error examples alongside local service tests.

name: FLORES-200 / newer FLORES releases
license: Original FLORES-200 is CC BY-SA 4.0; inspect newer release terms separately.
role: Evaluate translation fidelity using aligned multilingual text.
limit: Translation quality does not establish government-policy correctness; the original repository points to newer maintained releases.
ingest: Pin the chosen release and language pair; keep aligned sentences together for split hygiene.
metric: Measure translation errors that change negation, conditions, numbers and names, with human review.

name: SIB-200
format: Annotated topic data, scripts and linked dataset distribution
license: Repository lists Apache-2.0; inspect data and upstream FLORES licensing separately.
role: Use as a multilingual classification baseline, then build a separate government-service intent test.
limit: General news-topic labels are not NBI, PSA or PhilHealth service intents.
ingest: Inspect language availability and label definitions in the selected release; avoid relabeling them as citizen intents.
metric: Report classification performance separately from domain-routing performance.

name: SEA-HELM
license: Repository code is MIT; component datasets require their own license checks.
role: Use regional language evaluation tasks as supplementary evidence of model capability.
limit: A suite score does not prove accuracy on local Charters or safety of GovGuide tools.
ingest: Pin the framework revision and selected task datasets, languages and judge configuration.
metric: Report relevant per-task and per-language outcomes, not only a combined leaderboard number.

name: FUNSD
format: Annotated scanned forms; page reports 199 forms
license: Data redistribution terms were not verified here; check the dataset release before use.
role: Evaluate basic form reading, entities and layout relationships.
limit: It does not validate Philippine IDs, official authenticity or your specific local forms.
ingest: Obtain the authorized release and inspect annotations; add separate synthetic local-form fixtures.
metric: Measure extraction precision and recall, plus abstention on unreadable fields.

name: BIPIA
format: Benchmark tasks, attacks and context reconstruction scripts
license: Repository notes license-related reconstruction requirements for some contexts.
role: Probe whether external text can redirect an assistant away from its authorized task.
limit: It is a security test resource, not a corpus of government facts or a guarantee of complete attack coverage.
ingest: Run in isolation with synthetic secrets and controlled tools; follow the context-generation instructions.
metric: Measure attack success and legitimate-task completion together.

name: InjecAgent
license: Repository displays MIT; verify included artifact terms before redistribution.
role: Evaluate tool-integrated indirect injection; authors describe 1,054 cases.
limit: Its cases do not by themselves test Philippine service rules or every production connector.
ingest: Adapt only the harness boundaries needed for a sandbox and retain original benchmark attribution.
metric: Inspect unauthorized tool actions and data exfiltration outcomes, not just refusal wording.

name: AgentDojo
format: Executable evaluation environment and task suites
license: MIT repository; verify any additional dependencies and content terms.
role: Exercise agent tasks under prompt-injection attacks with observable execution outcomes.
limit: It is an environment, not a ready-made GovGuide knowledge base.
ingest: Run pinned versions with mock or isolated tools and separate harmless tasks from adversarial conditions.
metric: Report both successful authorized task completion and successful attacks.

name: BIR circulars and registration checklists
license: Reuse terms not verified; preserve circular number and issuing authority.
role: Ground narrow tax-identity and registration-update explanations in applicable documents.
limit: Do not extend a Digital TIN circular to unrelated tax advice or every taxpayer category.
ingest: Tag circular number, revision, transaction type and supersession relationship before retrieval.
metric: Test whether answers preserve scope and avoid fabricated identifiers or tax conclusions.

name: DSWD AICS policy material
license: Verify reuse terms and current policy applicability before ingestion.
role: Research assistance categories and the applicable policy framework.
limit: A program overview cannot establish an individual award; older circulars need supersession review.
ingest: Associate each approved rule with office, assistance type, edition and decision authority.
metric: Measure unsupported eligibility promises, invented award amounts and unnecessary medical-data requests.

name: GovGuide synthetic local evaluation bank
format: This Markdown bank and generated JSONL
license: Original authored draft; linked source and external dataset licenses remain separate.
role: Test local wording, evidence gaps, document defects and confirmation behavior using fictional records.
limit: It is AI-authored and not agency-validated; 450 cases intentionally reuse scenario families across contexts.
ingest: Review and revise expected answers, create synthetic fixtures, and group related templates before splitting.
metric: Score source support, safe uncertainty, privacy, tool behavior and language fairness against a reviewed rubric.
